# graph-manager: sandbox settings — limits in Settings and the image per workspace (KAN-88) ## What to build Two settings, server and UI, both stored in `graph-manager.json` (the schema already has them: `sandboxLimits: { cpus, memoryMb, pids }` with defaults 2 / 4096 / 2048, and `workspaceSettings: Record`; see `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts`): 1. **Settings → Sandbox card**: shows the Docker status (`GET /api/sandbox/status` → `{ available, reason?, defaultImage? }`, already served by `src/server/routes/sandbox.ts`), the default image, and three number fields — CPUs, Memory (MB), PIDs — saved with `PUT /api/settings/sandbox`. `GET /api/settings/sandbox` returns `{ limits: { cpus, memoryMb, pids } }`. 2. **Workspace sandbox image**: `GET /api/workspaces/:id/settings` → `{ image: string | null, sandbox: boolean }` and `PUT /api/workspaces/:id/settings` `{ image: string | null }` (empty/`null` = the default image). On the Workspaces page, each row gets a **Settings** button opening a small drawer "Workspace settings · " with a **Sandbox image** input (placeholder: the default image or "graph-manager's image"), hint "Needs node 20+ and git. Empty: the default image.", and Save. The sandbox start (`Sandboxes.start` in `src/server/sandbox.ts`, built in another slice of this feature, possibly at the same time as this one) reads `store.get().sandboxLimits` and `workspaceSettings[ws.id]?.image` when it creates a container, so a saved value applies to the next sandboxed run. This slice only reads and writes the stored values; do not touch `Sandboxes.start` or `routes/runs.ts`. Spec: `docs/prd/sandboxes.md` — Requirements bullets "Workspaces: each workspace gets a Sandbox image setting…" and "Settings: a Sandbox card…"; user stories 3, 4 and 6 (status visible). Other suite features (KAN-87) add their own card to `Settings.tsx` in parallel: put the card in its own component file and add ONE line to `Settings.tsx`. `workspaceSettings[id].sandbox` is written by the start route; this slice must keep it when saving `image`. ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/sandbox.ts` — `sandboxRoutes(app, ctx)` with `GET /api/sandbox/status`; add the new routes here. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` — `dataSchema` (the `sandboxLimits` and `workspaceSettings` keys), `DataStore.update(fn)`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/forges.ts` (lines 38-78) — PUT routes with a zod body `.parse(req.body ?? {})` and the global ZodError → 400 handler (`app.ts:56-61`, answers `{ error: ": " }`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/workspaces.ts` — `resolveWorkspace(root, id)` → `Workspace | undefined` (404 `{ error: "unknown workspace" }`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.test.ts` (lines 1-40) — route test pattern (`appWithLogin`, a workspace dir with `git init`, `app.inject`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.tsx` (lines 172-196) — the page: forge cards, then the Appearance card; add `` after `settings-forges` and before Appearance. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Settings.css` — `.settings-card`, `.settings-card-head`, `.forge-form`, badges `badge tone-ok` / `tone-mute` with `glyph-dot` / `glyph-ring` (Settings.tsx:81-91). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/Settings.test.tsx` (lines 1-70) — the page test: `fakeApi()` stubs `fetch` by URL + method; render inside `ToastProvider` + `OverviewProvider`. Its `fakeApi` answers 404 for unknown URLs — the Sandbox card must render a sensible state on 404/errors (so the existing tests keep passing), and you add `/api/sandbox/status` and `/api/settings/sandbox` to it for the new tests. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.tsx` (lines 190-262 the row; 294 `CloneDrawer` usage) and `pages/CloneDrawer.tsx` — a drawer opened from the page; `ui/Drawer.tsx` (`Drawer({ open, title, onClose, footer, children, testId })`). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Workspaces.test.tsx` — the page test to extend. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/api.ts` — `api(path, init)`, `post(path, body, method = "POST")`, `ApiError` (`.error` text). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` — client copies of API shapes; add `SandboxStatus`, `SandboxLimits`, `WorkspaceSettings`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/toast.tsx` — `useToast().show({ tone: "ok" | "bad", text })`. ## Patterns to follow ```ts // routes/forges.ts — zod body, PUT app.put("/api/forges/github", async (req) => { const { token } = githubBody.parse(req.body ?? {}); ... }); ``` ```tsx // Settings.tsx:78-92 — a card with a head and a status badge
